kind: static semantic-parity audit of the logical quality evaluator vs canonical RABIT (offline; no GPU, no model execution)
logical_evaluator: benchmarks/quality/{continuation_ppl,niah,passage_retrieval,hotpotqa,qasper}.py (quantizer functions semantically identical across the five; continuation_ppl differs only by variable renames, alpha-normalized AST equal); also benchmarks/quality/multilingual_ppl.py and the derived Exp7-11 scripts contain the same HF-layout quantizer
canonical_reference: vllm-kvquant/vllm/v1/attention/ops/kvquant_k3.py quantize_rabit2_kv_ref / dequantize_rabit2_kv_ref ([T, H, D] layout); Rabit2OnlineStateRef equals it (tests/quantization/test_rabit_kv2_physical.py); physical pages byte-identical to the reference state

1_v_metadata_grouping_mismatch.old_logical_flattening_order: (head, token, V-group) -- HF cache layout [B, H_kv, T, D], V primary min / scale shaped [B, H, T, 4, 1] flattened before META8g64
1_v_metadata_grouping_mismatch.canonical_flattening_order: (token, head, V-group) -- oracle [T, H, 4, 1] and physical page order v_idx = (t * NUM_KV_HEADS + kvh) * V_GROUPS + vg
1_v_metadata_grouping_mismatch.affects: BOTH models (layout-order difference, not a head-count-specific bug)

2_generation_cache_aging_mismatch.old_logical: prefix K / V quantized and dequantized ONCE after the BF16 prefill; K / V of every later token (last prompt token, generated / continuation tokens) remain BF16 for the rest of the sequence
2_generation_cache_aging_mismatch.canonical: newest R4 = 4 tokens residual BF16; older tokens age through the canonical online state (open group -> closed 32-token pages) and open / closed transitions continue during decode

findings.3_repeated_requantization: NOT found: each prefix token is quantized once; later tokens are never quantized in the old harness
findings.4_matching_semantics: K3 sequence-axis affine G32 codes (incl. zero-padded incomplete group) and V2 per-token last-dimension G32 primary codes matched; K META8g64 groups identical (Qwen 504 / 504, Llama 1008 / 1008)
findings.5_rope_cache_point: matched: in transformers 4.48.2 both Qwen2 and Llama project to [B, H_kv, T, D], apply RoPE, then call past_key_value.update (post-RoPE K); same conceptual tensor as the physical vLLM KV write. Model difference: Qwen2 k_proj / v_proj bias=True; Llama attention_bias=False

provenance_conclusion.status_of_affected: valid measurements of the OLD logical evaluator; NOT canonical physical-RABIT quality evidence

cpu_parity_tests_in_audit: index-level grouping parity only (local torch unavailable: Windows VC++ runtime); numeric parity deferred to the canonical-quality-v2 repair
